visualization.name: Big Tree Viewer
visualization.help:
# What is Big Tree Viewer?
Big Tree Viewer draws **phylogenetic trees with hundreds of thousands of tips** smoothly in your browser.
After selecting a `newick`, `nhx` or `nex` dataset, the tree opens in the viewer, where you can pan, zoom and collapse clades.
## Key Features
- **Layouts**: Rectangular, radial and spiral layouts. - **Taxonomy**: Map tip names to NCBI or Catalogue of Life taxonomy and show taxonomic ribbons. - **Metadata**: Color branches and add markers from a CSV or TSV table. - **Export**: Save publication-quality SVG or PNG figures.
To learn more about Big Tree Viewer, visit: [https://bigtreeviewer.net](https://bigtreeviewer.net)
